ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% low-intensity (black/dark grey) to 15% high-intensity (white) across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity central mass with high-intensity pigmentation concentrated at the lateral tips. localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel, dark vertical linear disruptions (rake marks) are visible within the white pigmentation area of the left lobe tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular notch/loss of tissue on the upper trailing edge of the right lobe; extensive barnacle colonization on both lateral extremities.
